company.name: Zomato
company.description:
Zomato is a multi-service food platform operating in over 19 countries, specializing in restaurant discovery, online food delivery, dining reservations, and supply chain solutions for the food industry. Initially established as a restaurant review platform, Zomato has evolved to include a robust food delivery service, which is its primary revenue driver. The platform delivers approximately 1.3 million orders daily from over 150,000 restaurants across 556+ Indian cities and has expanded to around 700 cities globally.

In addition to food delivery, Zomato offers logistics services through its subsidiary Runnr, which fulfills around 300,000 orders monthly. The company also provides fresh ingredients to restaurants via its Hyperpure service, operating large warehouses in major cities. Zomato has embraced cloud kitchens to enhance service in specific areas, managing 663 kitchen units across 50 cities in India. Furthermore, Zomato utilizes its advertising platform, AdOnMo, to create value for its stakeholders.

research.summary: Zomato is a large-scale multi-service food technology platform headquartered in India, operating across 19+ countries with a core focus on food delivery, restaurant discovery, logistics, and supply chain solutions. With approximately 4,000 employees and 1.3 million daily orders, Zomato represents a mature, operationally complex B2B and B2C ecosystem. The company has diversified beyond delivery into cloud kitchens, fresh ingredient supply (Hyperpure), and advertising (AdOnMo), signaling a platform-centric growth model. Current hiring signals indicate modest but targeted investment in AI and engineering, suggesting selective capability building rather than aggressive headcount expansion.
pain_points: Managing and integrating a highly fragmented technology stack across multiple services and geographies
Real-time logistics coordination and last-mile delivery optimization at scale (1.3M+ daily orders)
Data silos between delivery, supply chain (Hyperpure), logistics (Runnr), and cloud kitchen operations
High operational costs associated with warehousing, cold chain logistics, and kitchen management
Restaurant partner onboarding, retention, and engagement at scale (150,000+ restaurants)
Customer retention and reducing churn in a highly competitive food delivery market
Fraud detection and payment security across a high-volume transaction environment
Talent acquisition and retention in competitive AI and engineering roles
Regulatory and compliance complexity across 19+ international markets
strategic_priorities: Deepening AI and machine learning capabilities for personalization, demand forecasting, and logistics optimization
Expanding Hyperpure supply chain operations to more cities and restaurant partners
Scaling cloud kitchen infrastructure across Indian and global markets
Monetizing the advertising platform (AdOnMo) to diversify revenue beyond delivery commissions
Improving unit economics and operational efficiency across delivery and logistics verticals
International market consolidation and selective global expansion
Enhancing restaurant partner tools and B2B services to increase platform stickiness
